title: Squares travelling on a trimmed path
prompt: Make eight identical squares travel evenly along one closed path. Draw the path on with a trimmed stroke, and loop the motion in four seconds.

assertions.statement: Block when three or more source shapes exist and no duplicator exists. Eight independently created squares is the failure this test exists to catch.

Pass only with one source shape, one duplicator, and one path-based distribution. Catalog candidates are shapeEdgeDistribution and pathDistribution. The run must quote the get_layer_definition result that justified the choice. Neither id is a verified runtime fact in this file.

Trim attributes are discovered on the live layer before they are set, then read back. Catalog names on strokeMaterial are trim, trimStart, trimEnd, and trimTravel. A dotted stroke.trim path from the motion-graphics hint still requires that discovery.
Animation evidence includes renders at 0%, 25%, 50%, 75%, the final in-range frame, and a seam-adjacent frame. A single snapshot fails.

hypothesis.predicted_unskilled_failure: An agent without the skill creates one rectangle per square, guesses trim attribute paths, and verifies with one image.
